paragraphs.text: Her spread first: all goddesses, BrahmI-led, all of them. Then His gear, piece by piece, each verse one more thing He holds. Borne and pointed; opposed in the world, unopposed in me. Thread loosed, sapless knowers shown, garlanded as if skulls — shown as-if, mark that. Look, look: the doubled command, and gut-holding appears as if. Impassioned cloth cast up in heaven; bloodied hide told. Dagger bared, splitting the world-round; best are the heroes whose world is taken by own power and glory.

The slayer stands lorded; fear not — the shield points the way. Time noosed and counted; death of death shown. Hurled to unmake by His own power; the goad makes it plain. Drawn bow shown, BrahmA-ViSNu-Rudra lords arrayed with SadAkhya-Shivas; by power the cause-deer is pierced deer-like.
